contract_gaps.title: HTTPS adapter insecure-option detector contradiction
contract_gaps.provenance: Auditor required '--insecure' absent globally while simultaneously requiring the policy comment 'No -k/--insecure', making the condition self-contradictory.
contract_gaps.resolution_contract: Only executable option-shaped shell lines count as active -k/--insecure; comments do not. A negative test injects a real --insecure line and must be rejected.
contract_gaps.F_next: Require current browser/TLS tests and First Part unit suite to PASS; runtime TLS remains TOKEN_VAZIO.

contract_gaps.title: structural closure expected obsolete source proof v2
contract_gaps.provenance: Structural closure rejected the current source proof schema raf.apkc.source-to-binary-proof.v3 because its constant and fixtures still expected v2.
contract_gaps.resolution_contract: Current structural closure requires v3 and a dedicated negative test rejects historical v2 fail-closed.
contract_gaps.F_next: Require current structural closure unit suite to PASS and preserve v2 only as historical evidence, not current input.

real_fixture_gap.title: single ASM fixture is ARM64-specific but verified build requests -both
real_fixture_gap.provenance: Apkc/hello.s.txt declares Architecture: arm64 and contains AArch64 registers/instructions; verified build requests -lang asm -both. ARM32 assembler emitted UNDEF placeholders and strict mode refused APK generation.
real_fixture_gap.forbidden_shortcut: Do not use --allow-undef to force green evidence.
real_fixture_gap.F_next: Define a dual-ABI fixture contract using either paired ARM64/ARM32 sources or a proven common mnemonic subset; bind both source hashes and require strict zero-UNDEF generation before structural closure.
